column1: # Forge 1.20.1 Tags constants and what each reads on a NeoForge host.
#   GROUP       the nested class: Items, Blocks, Biomes, Fluids or EntityTypes
#   KIND        same: NeoForge's Tags constant of the same name
#               field: NeoForge's Tags constant named TARGET, the c: tag the forge: tag became
#               vanilla: vanilla ItemTags constant named TARGET
#               forge: no host constant means the same thing, so the forge: id is kept and a
#                      mod's own data under that id still fills it
#   FORGE_PATH  the path of the forge: tag the constant held on Forge 1.20.1
#   HOST_SINCE  optional: the first NeoForge host with TARGET, which an offline run without host jars
#               checks; NeoForge 21.1 and 21.11 have no TOOLS_TRIDENT, 26.1 has it
# Generated from Forge 1.20.1-47.4.10 and NeoForge 26.3.0.43-beta static initializers, matched
# through forge-convention-tags.tsv. A same or field row whose constant a host lacks (NeoForge
# 21.1 has no TOOLS_TRIDENT) falls back to the forge: id there.
# Five same rows land on a neoforge: tag (ENCHANTING_FUELS, ENDERMAN_PLACE_ON_BLACKLIST and the
# three NEEDS_*_TOOL constants). They read NeoForge's tag, but a mod's own data under the old
# forge: id does not move to neoforge:, so those entries stay out of the tag.
